keyVerseDR: "I will have mercy and not sacrifice. For I am not come to call the just, but sinners." (Mt 9:13)

level1.title: Jesus Calls Matthew
level1.story: Matthew was a tax collector. Jesus said, "Follow Me!" Matthew got up and followed Him.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for loving me. Amen.

activity.title: Tell my parents
activity.intro: Write one line about today's Gospel to tell your family.

level2.title: Mercy, Not Sacrifice
level2.story: Jesus saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth and said, "Follow Me." Matthew got up and followed Him. Later, Jesus ate at Matthew's house with many tax collectors and sinners. The Pharisees asked, "Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?" Jesus said, "Those who are well do not need a doctor, but the sick do. I came to call sinners."
level2.keyLine: I will have mercy and not sacrifice.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can you show mercy to someone left out?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Divine Physician, heal my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Who am I?
clues: I sat at a tax booth collecting money.
I hosted a dinner for Jesus and sinners.
